maturityDimensions.label: Notation paintable
maturityDimensions.claim: The selected renderer can paint the notation without asserting its meaning.

maturityDimensions.label: Semantic shape representable
maturityDimensions.claim: Typed roles, grouping, scope, identity, domain, and branch evidence can represent the source and target.

maturityDimensions.label: Operation authoritative
maturityDimensions.claim: A registered semantic operation validates the transformation or returns an exact typed gap.

maturityDimensions.label: Exemplar executable
maturityDimensions.claim: One deterministic, seekable, reversible caller exercises the operation through a real renderer.

maturityDimensions.label: Family promoted
maturityDimensions.claim: A reviewed exemplar and structurally different caller prove a bounded shared recipe.

maturityDimensions.label: Generation governed
maturityDimensions.claim: Natural-language or ordered-source authoring resolves only through registered evidence and typed repair.
